item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 26/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Under the influence of a strong northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler in the morning and brighter during the day over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coastal areas over the weekend.
